title: Blue Dragon
shortDescription: Hironobu Sakaguchi, character designer Akira Toriyama, and composer Nobuo Uematsu unite on an epic shadow-manifesting JRPG.
historicalSignificance: Brought legendary Japanese creative talent to the Xbox platform with charming art direction and deep class mechanics.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
